diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/pin-verify/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/pin-verify/kind.yml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..54214c36cf5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/pin-verify/kind.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+---
+loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
+
+kind-dependencies:
+    - fetch
+    - toolchain
+
+transforms:
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job:transforms
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
+
+tasks:
+    pin-verify:
+        description: Checks if gecko_rev.yml is pinned to the latest tag
+        run-on-projects: [comm-beta, comm-release, comm-esr128, comm-esr140]
+        index:
+            product: thunderbird
+            job-name: pin-verify
+        treeherder:
+            kind: test
+            platform: thunderbird-release/opt
+            symbol: pin-verify
+            tier: 2
+        worker-type: t-linux-docker-noscratch
+        worker:
+            docker-image: {in-tree: "debian12-base"}
+            max-run-time: 1800
+            env:
+                TASK_ID: {"task-reference": "<self>"}
+                TASKCLUSTER_PROXY_URL: http://taskcluster
+        run:
+            using: run-task
+            comm-checkout: true
+            cwd: '{checkout}'
+            command: >
+                ./comm/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh
diff --git a/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh b/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh
new file mode 100755
index 00000000000..7d37befa45a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+
+set -xe
+
+echo "Checking if repo is pinned to an upstream tag..."
+
+# Extract GECKO_HEAD_REF from YAML file
+GECKO_HEAD_REF=$(awk -F': ' '/^GECKO_HEAD_REF:/ {print $2}' ../../.gecko_rev.yml | xargs)
+
+if [[ -z "$GECKO_HEAD_REF" || "$GECKO_HEAD_REF" == "default" ]]; then  # If GECKO_HEAD_REF is not set or is set to 'default'
+    echo "GECKO_HEAD_REF is not pinned to a tag or a commit hash; was this on purpose?"
+    exit 1
+elif [[ "$GECKO_HEAD_REF" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{12,40}$ ]]; then  # If GECKO_HEAD_REF is a commit hash (12–40 characters hexadecimal)
+    echo "GECKO_HEAD_REF is pinned to a commit hash ($GECKO_HEAD_REF) instead of a tag; was this on purpose?"
+    exit 1
+elif [[ ! "$GECKO_HEAD_REF" =~ ^FIREFOX_ ]]; then  # If GECKO_HEAD_REF is not a Firefox tag
+    echo "GECKO_HEAD_REF appears to be incorrectly pinned to '$GECKO_HEAD_REF'"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+echo "GECKO_HEAD_REF is correctly pinned to an upstream tag ($GECKO_HEAD_REF)"
title: Bug 1980903 - Add .gecko_rev.yml pin verify. r=coreycb
